messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image, using the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image. Use the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands on a rooftop, turning her body and head to look around while posing with one hand on her hip and the other raised near her head.","camera":"A static, medium-full shot from a slightly low angle that keeps the character centered in the frame.","clothing":"A short, white dress with a pink and purple floral pattern, three-quarter sleeves, and a low open back, paired with pink slip-on shoes.","hair_color":"White or very light silver.","hairstyle":"Short, wavy hair tied back in a small low bun with a white hair tie.","identity":"A 3D-rendered female character with a slim build and light skin.","scene":"An outdoor city rooftop at dusk, featuring a tiled floor, a metal railing, and a background of high-rise buildings, construction cranes, and a large sign with Japanese characters."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background changed from a cobblestone European-style street with brick buildings, a Union Jack flag, and shop signs to a tiled city rooftop at dusk with high-rise buildings, construction cranes, a metal structure, and a large sign with Japanese characters. The character, floral dress, pink shoes, silver hair, pose sequence, and centered medium-full framing remain largely consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the original street scene with the rooftop environment from the reference image while preserving the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, action, camera framing, and natural lighting.
uncertain: Fine facial expression continuity is difficult to verify from the available frames.
unexpected_changes: The character's lighting and shadows now match the warm dusk rooftop environment, which is expected but changes the overall color cast compared with the source.
